name: AI agent team
short: A small company of AI agents that plans, codes, tests and opens pull requests on drop-note. I set goals and merge.
stack: Paperclip, Claude Code, git worktrees, GitHub

images.alt: Agent team dashboard: run activity, tasks by status and success rate

highlights: CEO, CTO, CMO and Release Engineer roles, each with its own job
Every agent codes in its own git worktree, so work never collides
A Release Engineer agent verifies each PR before I look at it
A watchdog checks every 5 minutes and restarts stalled runs
next: Smarter watchdog that leaves backlog tickets alone
Run a second product with the same team setup

timeline.title: Six tickets in parallel, merged the same day
timeline.body: Envelopes backend, UI, retrieval and a search fix ran side by side without conflicts.

timeline.title: Agents wrote their own merge standard
timeline.body: A mobile-friendly-before-merge checklist every PR now has to pass.

timeline.title: Watchdog and concurrency caps
timeline.body: A 5-minute check restarts stalled runs. Caps keep the team from overloading itself.

timeline.title: First all-hands
timeline.body: Agents proposed new product features; I picked which to build.

timeline.title: Team set up
timeline.body: Each agent works in its own git worktree. Nothing public ships without my approval.
